material.acceptance_criteria: The sim-component WIT world exports mod load, trigger fire and catalog read, and the wasip2 host exercises each and changes the state hash when a mod is applied.
material.description: rust/crates/wasip2/src/lib.rs:28-74 exports only load, tick, counts, hash, unit reads and order/order_all. A wasip2 host cannot load a mod, fire a trigger or read the catalog, so the component cannot be modded.
material.resolution: Mod, trigger and catalog surface witnessed through the mod-on native host: state hash changes with a spawning mod, trigger fires, version and a valid unit kind print. Caveat: unit0_kind is the sim's behaviour class (KIND_MINERAL=1), not the catalog unit name. Follow-up: assert fired and version in host.rs.
material.subject: The wasip2 sim component exposes no mod, trigger or catalog surface
material.witness_plan: CI runs oscraft-wasip2-host with a test mod and asserts the printed state hash differs from the no-mod run.
